widget.doc: A small status or count label: tinted, 20 px high, radius 5 (a pill for counts), as wide as its text.

props.doc: neutral, primary, success, warning, error or info: a 10 % tint, a matching hairline, the tone's ink.
A 6 px dot of the tone before the text (a status).
Fully rounded (a count); rounded corners (radius 5) otherwise.

bind.decoration.fills[0].color: ${= props.tone == 'neutral' ? theme.colors.neutralTint : (props.tone == 'primary' ? theme.colors.primaryTint : (props.tone == 'success' ? theme.colors.successTint : (props.tone == 'warning' ? theme.colors.warningTint : (props.tone == 'error' ? theme.colors.errorTint : theme.colors.infoTint))))}
bind.decoration.strokes[0].color: ${= props.tone == 'neutral' ? theme.colors.neutralTintBorder : (props.tone == 'primary' ? theme.colors.primaryTintBorder : (props.tone == 'success' ? theme.colors.successTintBorder : (props.tone == 'warning' ? theme.colors.warningTintBorder : (props.tone == 'error' ? theme.colors.errorTintBorder : theme.colors.infoTintBorder))))}

bind.decoration.fills[0].color: ${= props.tone == 'neutral' ? theme.colors.secondaryText : (props.tone == 'primary' ? theme.primary : (props.tone == 'success' ? theme.success : (props.tone == 'warning' ? theme.warning : (props.tone == 'error' ? theme.error : theme.colors.info))))}

bind.props.style.color: ${= props.tone == 'neutral' ? theme.colors.secondaryText : (props.tone == 'primary' ? theme.primary : (props.tone == 'success' ? theme.success : (props.tone == 'warning' ? theme.warning : (props.tone == 'error' ? theme.error : theme.colors.info))))}
